caption: The drawing features three main objects arranged within a light rectangular border on a cream background. At the top left is a wooden and metal stamp with a round, reddish-brown handle and a silvery metallic base. The base of the stamp faces downward and displays an engraved design. To the right of the stamp are two circular impressions, both featuring the same design: the top impression is rendered in gray tones with clear detail, and the bottom impression is lighter and more faded. The design on each impression consists of a central animal, likely a camel, beside a flag, with both surrounded by a wreath and encircled by the text "HENDRIX CO. BANKSOFHILL COLONY LTD." The artist’s name, "WELLINGTON BLEWETT," appears in small capital letters below the objects.
title: Bishop Hill: Seal
